name: Ready, Set, Block!
detailed_description:
Are you ready? Ready to outsmart your opponents and claim victory?

Dive into the world of Ready, Set, Block!, the ultimate PvP turn-based board game where every move counts and strategy is your best friend. Choose from a diverse roster of characters, each with unique abilities, and compete locally with friends or our simple AI, join online lobbies, or jump into random online matchmaking. Place blocks to disrupt your rivals, wield powerful items, and navigate diverse terrains to outmaneuver the competition. Can you reach the other side first and become the ultimate champion?

Sharpen your wits, flex those brain muscles, and get ready to set some blocks!

Key Features

  • Strategic Block Placement – Cut off paths, trap enemies, or create new routes with blocks each turn.

  • Unique Characters – Choose from a growing roster of characters, each with special abilities that change how you play.

  • Items – Use game-changing tools to speed ahead or throw opponents off course.

  • Multiple Game Modes – Play solo against AI, locally with friends, or online in public or private lobbies.

  • Random Matchmaking – Jump into quick online games with players around the world.

  • Simple to Learn, Tough to Master – Easy controls and mechanics with deep strategic possibilities.

short_description: "Ready, Set, Block!" is a fast-paced PvP board game where players race to reach the opposite side first. Place blocks to slow opponents, use character abilities and items to outwit rivals, and plan your moves carefully in this turn-based, tactical race. Play locally, online, or vs AI.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS *: Windows 7 or greater
  • Processor: x86_32 CPU with SSE2 instructions, any x86_64 CPU, ARMv8 CPU
  • Memory: 2 GB RAM
  • Graphics: 128MB
  • Storage: 200 MB available space
  • Sound Card: N/A

mac_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: macOS 10.13 or greater
  • Processor: x86_64 or ARM CPU (Apple Silicon)
  • Memory: 2 GB RAM
  • Graphics: 128MB
  • Storage: 250 MB available space

linux_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Linux distribution released after 2016
  • Processor: x86_32 CPU with SSE2 instructions, x86_64 CPU, ARMv7 or ARMv8 CPU
  • Memory: 2 GB RAM
  • Graphics: 128MB
  • Storage: 200 MB available space
